title: KEDA operator Prometheus metrics renamed; the old names are still exposed for now

detection.reason: which metric names a dashboard, alert or recording rule reads is not in the collected projection

quote: Various Prometheus metrics have been renamed to follow the preferred naming conventions. The old ones are still available, but will be removed in the future (#4854).
remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules to the new names; both are exposed until 2.17 removes the old ones: `keda_scaler_metrics_latency` → `keda_scaler_metrics_latency_seconds`; `keda_scaler_errors` → `keda_scaler_detail_errors_total`; `keda_scaler_errors_total` → `sum(keda_scaler_detail_errors_total)`; `keda_scaled_object_errors` → `keda_scaled_object_errors_total`; `keda_scaled_job_errors` → `keda_scaled_job_errors_total`; `keda_trigger_totals` → `keda_trigger_registered_total`; `keda_resource_totals` → `keda_resource_registered_total`; `keda_internal_scale_loop_latency` → `keda_internal_scale_loop_latency_seconds`. (`keda_metrics_adapter_*` is not part of this rename — it left with the adapter endpoint in 2.11.)
verifyCommand: kubectl get prometheusrules.monitoring.coreos.com -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.groups[]?.rules[]?.expr | test("keda_metrics_adapter_")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a rule file still using a pre-2.14 metric name
